releases.body:
First release built and published from GitHub Actions with npm provenance. No functional changes from v0.1.0.

Install: `opencode plugin add @tamelabs/opencode-claudeway`

**Experimental and unofficial. Use at your own risk.**

First npm release: `opencode plugin add @tamelabs/opencode-claudeway`.

- Published as `@tamelabs/opencode-claudeway`
- English README (Spanish in `README.es.md`)
- Release workflow with trusted publishing and npm provenance
- CONTRIBUTING, issue templates and security policy

**Experimental and unofficial. Use at your own risk.** See the README for limits and Anthropic terms.

Primer pre-release experimental de Claudeway.

- Integración con OpenCode V2 (`2.0.29`) en JavaScript ESM.
- Renovación OAuth bajo demanda, con bloqueo de archivo y recuperación.
- Validado solo con fixtures; sin renovación real. macOS probado, Linux y Windows pendientes.

Consulta [docs/compatibility.md](docs/compatibility.md) antes de usarlo.
